post.description: Official ECB EUR exchange rates (e.g. EUR/USD reference rate on a date, latest EUR/JPY, a month of EUR/GBP), or a cross rate such as USD/JPY computed from ECB reference rates.

base.description: With quote: also derive the cross rate quote-per-base (e.g. base USD, quote JPY gives JPY per 1 USD) from the two EUR legs on each common date. Non-EUR. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z]{3}$.

currencies.description: ISO 4217 codes of the currencies to quote against the euro, e.g. ["USD", "JPY", "GBP"]. Case-insensitive. EUR itself is not a series (every rate is per 1 EUR). Optional when base/quote is given.

date.description: One day, YYYY-MM-DD. Weekends and TARGET holidays have no rates (not_found). Mutually exclusive with start_date/end_date. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

end_date.description: Last day of a range, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

quote.description: With base: the currency the cross rate is expressed in. Non-EUR, different from base. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z]{3}$.

start_date.description: First day of a range, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

200.description:
Euro foreign exchange reference rates from the ECB (EXR dataflow, series D.{CUR}.EUR.SP00.A): units of each currency per 1 EUR for the latest business day (default), one date or a date range, each row with its actual observation date. Optionally derives a cross rate between two non-euro currencies (base/quote) from the EUR legs on the same date, flagged derived:true with its formula. ECB rates are published around 16:00 CET on TARGET business days, so 'latest' is often the previous business day.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `attribution` | string |  |
| `cross_rates` | object[] | Derived cross rates; empty unless base/quote was given. |
| `end_date` | string |  |
| `missing_currencies` | string[] | Requested currencies for which the ECB returned no series (not a reference-rate currency, or no data in the window). |
| `mode` | string |  |
| `modifications` | string | Statement of modification, present whenever derived cross rates are included (ECB reuse terms). |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Retrieval time, ms since the Unix epoch. |
| `publication_note` | string |  |
| `rates` | object[] | EUR reference rates, grouped by currency in request order (cross-rate legs included), oldest date first. |
| `source_url` | string | The ECB SDMX REST request this output was built from. |
| `start_date` | string |  |
| `terms_url` | string | ECB copyright and reuse terms: free reuse when reproduced accurately, the ECB is cited and any modification is stated. |

post.description: Finding which ECB dataflow holds a statistic, or which dimension codes make up a series key, before calling series.

code_query.description: With flow: keep only codes whose id or name contains this text, e.g. "dollar".

flow.description: Describe this dataflow instead of listing: its dimensions in key order with the codes that currently carry data, so a series key can be built.

key.description: With flow: a partial key that narrows the description, e.g. D..EUR.SP00.A for daily euro reference rates.

max_codes.description:
With flow: maximum codes listed per dimension.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 500; default 50.

query.description: Case-insensitive words that must all appear in the dataflow id, name or description, e.g. "exchange", "interest rate", "HICP". Empty lists all ECB dataflows.

post.description: Euro area statistics from the ECB: €STR (EST B.EU000A2X2A25.WT), key ECB interest rates (FM B.U2.EUR.4F.KR.MRR_FR.LEV, DFR, MLFR), HICP inflation (ICP M.U2.N.000000.4.ANR), M3 (BSI M.U2.Y.V.M30.X.1.U2.2300.Z01.E), bank lending rates (MIR), yield curves (YC), or any other ECB series key.

end_period.description: End of the period range, inclusive. SDMX period: 2025, 2025-03, 2025-03-31, 2025-Q1, 2025-S1 or 2025-W09.

flow.description: ECB dataflow id, e.g. EXR (exchange rates), EST (euro short-term rate), FM (financial markets incl. key policy rates), ICP (HICP inflation), BSI (monetary aggregates such as M3), MIR, YC. search_dataflows lists them.

key.description: SDMX series key: one code per dimension in order, separated by '.'; join alternatives with '+'; leave a position empty for any code. Examples: EST B.EU000A2X2A25.WT (€STR), FM B.U2.EUR.4F.KR.MRR_FR.LEV (main refinancing rate), FM B.U2.EUR.4F.KR.DFR.LEV (deposit facility rate), ICP M.U2.N.000000.4.ANR (euro area HICP annual rate), BSI M.U2.Y.V.M30.X.1.U2.2300.Z01.E (M3). search_dataflows with `flow` lists each dimension's codes.

last_n.description:
Only the last N observations of each series (within the range, when given). Without a range or last_n the full history is returned.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 10000.

max_series.description:
Maximum series returned for a wildcard key; more is reported as partial with total_series.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 200; default 25.

start_period.description: Start of the period range, inclusive. SDMX period: 2025, 2025-03, 2025-03-31, 2025-Q1, 2025-S1 or 2025-W09.
